_comment: Data for scripts/build-notices.ts. templates: standard licence text (without copyright line) for packages that declare a licence but ship no licence file; textOverrides: verbatim licence file for packages that ship none; assets: bundled media/fonts that are no packages (mustExist = artifacts that have to be present, otherwise the entry is stale or the artifact is missing). All text files live in notices-data/texts/.

npm:@microsoft/signalr.why: The npm package ships no licence file; package.json declares MIT and points to dotnet/aspnetcore (src/SignalR). Text: LICENSE.txt of that repository.

npm:tr46.why: The npm package ships no licence file; package.json declares MIT. Text: LICENSE.md of the repository.

nuget:SQLitePCLRaw.core.why: The NuGet packages declare Apache-2.0 by expression only and ship no licence file. Text: LICENSE.TXT plus NOTICE.TXT of the repository (tag v2.1.12 - there is no tag v2.1.13; LICENSE.TXT is identical on master, checked 2026-11-03). The NOTICE carries the licence of SQLite itself (public domain, the blessing), which lib.e_sqlite3 contains as native code.
